cells.gaps: No school is said to be using PLANETE 3 and no count or share of schools has been found: the source gives a launch and what the teacher module allows, not use. Kept disagrees: SEN-003 (2025-12, dated by publication) lists manual, paper-based collection of education data generally, after the launch, without naming learner records or primary schools. cells.note: PLANETE 3 was launched on 3 October 2025 for all cycles, primary newly brought in, and the source does not say it is past a pilot or name schools using it, so it is read as preparation. Stage 3 needs live use in some primary schools.
